name: San Diego Unified School District
districtFact: San Diego Unified publishes a traditional academic calendar with districtwide instructional days, holidays, and non-instructional days. Individual schools may publish additional minimum days, bell schedules, conferences, and campus events.

about.title: About the SDUSD Academic Calendar
about.content: San Diego Unified's academic calendar identifies districtwide instructional days, holidays, and non-instructional days for the traditional school year. It does not replace an individual school's calendar or bell schedule. Families should use the district calendar for the approved year structure, then check the student's school for minimum days, conferences, and campus-specific schedule changes. Independent charter schools may publish separate calendars.

planningTips.title: SDUSD Calendar Notes
content: Check the student's school calendar for minimum days, conferences, bell-time changes, and campus events that are not listed in the districtwide academic calendar.
Confirm dates directly with an independent charter school; charter calendars do not necessarily match the SDUSD traditional calendar.
Treat downloaded PDF and ICS files as snapshots. Recheck the official SDUSD calendar page for later revisions.

districtFaqs.q: Where can families find SDUSD minimum days?
districtFaqs.a: The districtwide academic calendar does not list every school-specific minimum day. Check the individual school's calendar and bell schedule before planning pickup, transportation, or childcare.

districtFaqs.q: Do charter schools follow the SDUSD calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Not necessarily. Independent charter schools may set their own calendars. Confirm dates directly with the school rather than assuming it follows the SDUSD traditional calendar.
